label: class_a_06_ecology_01
text: Hello, hello. I hope everyone’s ready to learn\nsome new things today![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_02
text: But before we get going, do you all remember\nthe final question from our midterm exam?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_03
text: Well, Director Clavell found out about it\nsomehow, and I got yelled at. Whoops.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_04
text: Apparently he could tell I was hiding something\njust by looking at me.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_05
text: He must’ve noticed all the color flush right out of\nmy face! Haha![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_06
text: Speaking of color, today I’d like to teach you\nall about colors as they pertain to Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_07
text: Some Pokémon have slightly different coloration\nor patterning on their bodies based on their\r\ngender or individual differences.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_08
text: In very rare cases, a Pokémon may have wildly\ndifferent coloration compared to others of the\r\nsame species.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_09
text: We call these specimens [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Shiny [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_10
text: It is quite rare to cross paths with one.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_11
text: Does anyone here know what the likelihood of\nfinding a Shiny Pokémon is?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_select_01
text: 1 in 40

label: class_a_06_ecology_answer_01
text: It would be nice if they were that common! We\nwould be able to do far more research on them.\r\nBut they’re actually quite a bit more rare.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_answer_02
text: That’s not a bad guess. But they’re actually\neven rarer than 1 in 400![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_answer_03
text: Wow! That’s right! You may have the makings of a\nPokémon Professor, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_12
text: Shiny Pokémon appear at a rate of 1 in 4,000.\nIsn’t that amazing?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_13
text: The probability of encountering one in the wild is\nthe same as hatching one from an Egg, too![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_14
text: Eggs from a pair of Pokémon raised around\ndiffering languages are a special case.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_15
text: There is a higher than average chance that\na Shiny Pokémon will hatch from these Eggs.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_16
text: But we haven’t been able to figure out why that is\njust yet.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_17
text: I’ve also heard rumors of a charm that increases\nyour likelihood of finding Shiny Pokémon when\r\nyou have it in your Bag—can you believe that?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_18
text: This claim can’t be scientifically verified, but it\nsure would be fun if it were true.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_19
text: Whoops...there’s the bell.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_06_ecology_20
text: That’s all for today. Thank you for your attention![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
